a.lede: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the question of whether the country is celebrating a company that has helped put advanced chips in its adversaries'
a.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion

b.lede: After saying that Nvidia's new CEO should come "outside the company," U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent now argues that former chief Jensen Huang "is on the outside," paving the way for a return following President Trump's declaration of his "hope" that Huang will be back.
b.title: President Trump says Nvidia board rehiring Jensen Huang would be best for the company and US
